title: Dream police??
content: Okay I’m just so curious if anyone else has had this experience because it was too real for me and has left me on edge for so long, but I feel like you all are my people so you might understand. 90 percent of the time I’m lucid in my dreams and also end up in the same places time and time again. One time I was in a school wandering around (aware that i was dreaming) and felt like everyone was staring at me and I was out of place. It started in a long hallway and then I ended up in a cafeteria setting and was just standing observing everyone while they were sitting. A very intense authoritative like lady approached me kinda aggressively and told me that I wasn’t supposed to be there and it seemed like something really bad was going to happen like she was calling people or something. But this girl came up to me who also didn’t seem to fit in there and rushed me to an empty room to hide me and after a while of sitting in there i woke up. To clarify i got the impression she was also lucid or something and had been through that before and somehow intervened right in time. And then after that the next few dreams i had a sense that I was being watched or had to hide or like I had tipped something off and they were aware of my presence. And i try to act really natural now when I’m dreaming but I really feel like there’s something out there that doesn’t want us aware we’re dreaming or like poking around??? It’s kinda unsettling tbh and wanted to know if anyone else has had a similar experience.
